newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark to cut mobile phone prices.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark to cut mobile phone prices.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark said on Monday it planned new cuts in mobile telephone call charges in the autumn.

"In the autumn we will announce low charges for both leisure time and standard subscribers over and above previously scheduled reductions to be introduced in August," Tele Danmark Mobile information manager John Joergensen told Reuters.

The group previously announced a halving of charges for leisure time mobile subscribers to 0.35 crown per minute from 5pm (1500 GMT) to 7am (0500 GMT), effective from August 1, with standard mobile subscriber off peak charges cut to 1.05 crowns per minute from 7.30pm (1730 GMT) to 8 am (0600 GMT).
Charges per minute for the rest of the day are four crowns for leisure time subscribers and 2.10 for standard users.
Tele Danmark's August mobile telephone charge cuts are due to the introduction of the new DCS 1800 system, Joergensen said. He gave no details of the upcoming autumn cuts.
